接口 StructuredTaskScope.Subtask<T>

所有父接口:

Enclosing interface:
StructuredTaskScope预览<T,R>
public static sealed interface StructuredTaskScope.Subtask<T> extends Supplier<T>
Subtask is a preview API of the Java platform.
Programs can only use Subtask when preview features are enabled.
Preview features may be removed in a future release, or upgraded to permanent features of the Java platform.
Represents a subtask forked with StructuredTaskScope.fork(Callable)预览 or StructuredTaskScope.fork(Runnable)预览.

Code that forks subtasks can use the get() method after joining预览 to obtain the result of a subtask that completed successfully. It can use the exception() method to obtain the exception thrown by a subtask that failed.

    • state

      StructuredTaskScope.Subtask.State预览 state()

    • get

      T get()
      Returns the result of this subtask if it completed successfully. If the subtask was forked with fork(Callable)预览 then the result from the call method is returned. If the subtask was forked with fork(Runnable)预览 then null is returned.

      Code executing in the scope owner thread can use this method to get the result of a successful subtask only after it has joined预览.

      Code executing in the Joiner onCompletePREVIEW method should test that the subtask state is SUCCESSPREVIEW before using this method to get the result.

      指定于:
      get in interface Supplier<T>
      返回:
      the possibly-null result
      抛出:
      IllegalStateException - if the subtask has not completed, did not complete successfully, or the current thread is the scope owner invoking this method before joining预览
      另见:
      • StructuredTaskScope.Subtask.State.SUCCESS预览

    • exception

      Throwable exception()
      Returns the exception or error thrown by this subtask if it failed. If the subtask was forked with fork(Callable)预览 then the exception or error thrown by the call method is returned. If the subtask was forked with fork(Runnable)预览 then the exception or error thrown by the run method is returned.

      Code executing in the scope owner thread can use this method to get the exception thrown by a failed subtask only after it has joined预览.

      Code executing in a Joiner onCompletePREVIEW method should test that the subtask state is FAILEDPREVIEW before using this method to get the exception.

      返回:
      the exception or error thrown by this subtask if it failed
      抛出:
      IllegalStateException - if the subtask has not completed, completed with a result, or the current thread is the scope owner invoking this method before joining预览
      另见:
      • StructuredTaskScope.Subtask.State.FAILED预览
